monster.turret_energy.name: EMG-764
monster.turret_fire.desc: A stationary automatic flamethrower with a homing system. Try not to be in the line of fire.
monster.turret_fire.name: Dragon-412

monster.unc_elite_female.name: Cannoneer

monster.unc_enforcer_UnchainedBelt_femal: Not every pirate can rise to the rank of boatswain, but the best weapons and a high percentage of the share in the division of the loot are worth it.
Not every pirate can rise to the rank of boatswain, but the best weapons and a high percentage of the share in the division of the loot are worth it.
monster.urparp_boss_carnage.desc: Urparp is the Principle of Form. Tyrant of Ur. Great Implementer of the Plan. He was brought to Earth by a clone who had wrought so much violence in his life that, where ordinary humans have a soul, there was enough space inside him to carry the Principle of Form through the shell of the Silver Sphere.
monster.urparp_boss_carnage.name: Urparp
monster.urparp_boss.desc: Urparp is The Principle of Form. Tyrant of Ur. Among his titles, there is: great implementer of the Plan. Xiomara doesn't talk much about Urparp. But from her words it becomes clear that he serves at the same time as an object of worship for the quasimorphs of Ur, a bogy for quasimorphs of other bramfaturas, and for some as yet unknown power inside the Sun, he is only something like a pet.
monster.urparp_boss.name: Urparp
monster.venus_acolyte.desc: The equipment of this quasimorph resembles ceremonial attire. Everything suggests that the society of Venus' Bramfatura is similar to some ancient human societies.
monster.venus_acolyte.name: Acolyte
monster.venus_baron.desc: Master of the Emerald Forests. Leader of the Knights of the Jaguar, Spider, Python, and others. According to AnCom's data, this quasimorph is the overseer of the accuracy of the rituals accompanying the extraction of gavvakh.
monster.venus_baron.name: Teohuatzin
monster.venus_custodian.desc: A quasimorph warrior who commands those below them. Acolytes and slaves of Gannix obey them without question.
monster.venus_custodian.name: Custodian
monster.venus_demon_cat.desc: A vicious, mindless predator who follows the very principle of Gannix: to kill quickly and quietly.
monster.venus_demon_cat.name: Tlatlauh
monster.venus_demon_warrior.desc: A warrior of the Venusian bramfatura. It's cruel, cunning and desperate. It knows that if it does not bring gavvakh to it's own master, the pitiful remains of spiritual liquid will be squeezed out of him.
monster.venus_demon_warrior.name: Taltnom
monster.venus_eagle_knight.desc: This quasimorph looks like it was designed for battle. These creatures cannot have a normal metabolism. No amount of energy would be enough to sustain this death machine.
monster.venus_eagle_knight.name: Eagle Knight
monster.venus_jaguar_knight.desc: This quasimorph is both intelligent and fierce. Its behavior reflects not only strength, agility, and a readiness to kill but also some level of cunning. There is even a hint of pride.
monster.venus_jaguar_knight.name: Jaguar Knight
monster.venus_ksiomara.desc: Xiomara was the free hierarch of the Venusian bramfatura. She was a spirit of freedom. Her knightly order war Order of Spider. After the return of Tezctlan, she rejects his idea of Emerald empire. There is only one empire in the Solar System, long lost Red and Gold Empire of Sun. Xiomara believes that Gannix is the Land of the Free. She can agree the position of chieftain for Tezctlan, the position of first among equals. But she will wage war against any self-proclaimed emperor of Gannix.
monster.venus_ksiomara.name: Xiomara
monster.venus_pact_baron.desc: Master of the Emerald Forests. Leader of the Knights of the Jaguar, Spider, Python, and others. According to AnCom's data, this quasimorph is the overseer of the accuracy of the rituals accompanying the extraction of gavvakh.
monster.venus_pact_baron.name: Teohuatzin
monster.venus_pact_vortex.desc: The blood wind of Gannix: a rite clothed in gore and made into a wandering storm.
monster.venus_pact_vortex.name: Eztli Ehecatl
monster.venus_slave.desc: The life of this quasimorph is eternal torment. Let's hope that the marginal theories about the reincarnation of humans after death in Bramfaturas are just theories.
monster.venus_slave.name: Slave
monster.venus_taskmaster.desc: A quasimorph warrior who came from the depths of Gannix to protect it by any means necessary.
monster.venus_taskmaster.name: Taskmaster
monster.victoria_boudicca_custom.desc: Your own shadow. Before you stands Boudicca, whom the others named Victoria for the victories she brings back from the depths of the hottest hells. The other clones dislike her intensely for the caustic sarcasm she inflicts on everyone around her.
